title: impatiens amphorata var. pallens
intro: Impatiens amphorata var. pallens, commonly known as a type of balsam plant, is a medicinal herb used in traditional medicine. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Impatiens amphorata var. pallens include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic, making it effective in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
